# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 50 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Writes the Tablets

---

**1** Seth wrote on tablets of stone and clay all the words of his father and mother and everything they had done.

**2** He wrote about the creation of the world, the fall in paradise, the penance of Adam and Eve, and the hope of the resurrection.

**3** He put these tablets in a safe place and said: 'These will be found in the last days.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
